newsitem.title: USA: PHLX to list Lucent LEAPS on Nov 18.
newsitem.headline: PHLX to list Lucent LEAPS on Nov 18.

text.p: The Philadelphia Stock Exchange (PHLX) said on Friday it will list Long-term Equity AnticiPation Securities (LEAPS) on Lucent Technologies Inc on November 18.

The exchange said the long term options would have expirations in January 1998 and January 1999, with initial strike prices at 40, 50 and 60. Lucent shares were off 1/8 at 49 in early afternoon trading Friday.
The PHLX said Spear, Leeds & Kellogg will be the specialist for the Lucent LEAPS. -Derivatives desk, 312 408 8750/Email: derivatives@reuters.com
